ai_note: No AI exposure in the analysis; growth and risk are drug approvals, NRDL pricing and clinical trial readouts.
why: The FY2025 revenue spike that put InnoCare on the list (18.1% -> 36.7% -> 135.3%) is not organic drug-sales acceleration: it is dominated by one-off licensing/milestone income from the October 2025 Zenas BioPharma and January 2025 Prolium deals (RMB932.5m of FY2025's RMB2,374.9m revenue), and RMB701.7m of that was paid in Zenas shares, not cash. The DCF's own historical_growth section flags this explicitly -- 'historical CAGRs are not usable as a forward proxy' -- and separates out drug-sales CAGR (36.5% 3yr) from the inflated total-revenue CAGR (56% 3yr, 344.8% 5yr). Growth is already slowing (H1 FY2026 +55.5% YoY vs FY2025's +135.3%), and the DCF's own base case has drug-sales growth of only 13.5% then 2% in the next two years once the Zenas milestone drops out.
watch: Not applicable for monitoring purposes -- recommend exclusion. If retained for any reason: Q3/FY2026 drug-sales growth ex-licensing (management guide is >35% YoY for drug sales alone, materially slower than the headline total-revenue figure)
NRDL renewal/VBP-style pricing risk on orelabrutinib (~90% of drug sales, second-mover behind BeiGene's zanubrutinib)
Binary Phase III readouts (SLE, Zenas-partnered MS, mesutoclax) that the bull/base cases depend on

Price HK$11.77 vs IV HK$14.45 (sanity_passed=true), entry price HK$10.10; ROIC 32.6% but 3yr average ROIC is -113.5% (the company was loss-making until FY2025), underscoring that current returns are a very recent, not yet proven, inflection
next_catalyst: Q3 2026 trading update and continued H2 licensing/milestone recognition (date not specified in the analysis); management said it would wait for Q3 2026 results before revising FY2026 guidance
exclude_reason: one-off: FY2025's 135.3% revenue jump is dominated by non-recurring Zenas/Prolium licensing and milestone income (partly share-settled, not cash), not a durable acceleration in drug sales; growth is already normalizing in H1 2026.
